units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 12b:2">Ab. Zar. 12ᵇ</cite> (<he>סכנת</he>) <he>ע׳</he> (Ms. M. <cite ref="P00844"><he>עַלְקָה</he></cite>; Ar. <cite ref="P00844"><he>עַלְקָא</he></cite>) the danger of swallowing a leech in drinking.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:5">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᶜ</cite> bot. (in Hebr. dict.) <he>פשפש לעֲלוּקְתָּה</he> a bed-bug is a remedy for a (swallowed) leech, (supposed to mean that a potion mixed with bed-bugs will cause the removal of the leech by causing vomiting).
